translations.source_sense_description: reflexiv: auffallen, weil es einen positiven Unterschied gibt

glosses: To surpass someone or something; to be better or do better than someone or something.

examples.text: I excelled everyone else with my exam results.

La Rochefoucauld, the French philosopher, said: "If you want enemies, excel your friends; but if you want friends, let your friends excel you." Why is that true? Because when our friends excel us, that gives them a feeling of importance; but when we excel them, that gives them a feeling of inferiority and arouses envy and jealousy.

glosses: To be much better than others.

examples.text: But it is as a destroyer of grasshoppers that the dickcissel excels.
